commons_claim: Drel hunts Cassik when temperature is at most 24°C AND drel_density is at least 30; otherwise it does not hunt.
evidence_summary: All six confirmed observations fit this rule exactly: hunted cases are (24,30), (23,39), and (22,35); non-hunted cases violate either the density or temperature condition.
